summary.headline: Part of Fortune in the Houses
summary.text: Chapter 49 explains the effects of the Head and Tail of the Dragon in the ninth through twelfth houses, including faith, mutations, fortune, mastery, oppression, enemies, and poverty. It then begins discussing the Part of Fortune in the twelve places of the natal theme, describing its significance in the first three houses for wealth, contracts, business, relatives, and religious life.
